messages:
Lina (CSM): Kicking off Quasar Health onboarding. Goal: production inference for triage assistant in 30 days, and clear renewal playbook if pilot meets adoption. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and early feedback loop.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can lead integration + perf testing. Question: do they need private deployment (VPC) or hosted?
Elena (Quasar Health - Eng): We require VPC for PHI handling. Also legal flagged embeddings retention — we need a clear policy.
Jordan (Onboarding PM): Proposed 6-week plan: Week 0: access + infra + kickoff; Weeks 1-2: API integration + smoke perf; Week 3: evals + quality tuning; Week 4: pilot w/ clinicians (n=8); Week 5: collect feedback + cost analysis; Week 6: go/no-go + renewal recommendation.
Lina (CSM): Success criteria (quantitative + qualitative): 1) p95 latency < 250ms for clinician prompts; 2) median cost per 1k tokens within approved budget; 3) 3 clinician workflows automated end-to-end; 4) post-pilot NPS >= 6/10; 5) security sign-off for PHI.
onboard-bot: Onboarding workspace created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Quasar-842 (team access only)
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll deliver a sample prompt bank + baseline perf numbers by Tue EOD. I'll also include a smaller, quantized model fallback for SLOs.
Elena (Quasar Health - Eng): Okta SSO is ready; metadata coming in a separate email. Also sending sample patient schema Monday.
Jordan (Onboarding PM): Risks: 1) PHI sign-off delay; 2) VPC networking window; 3) clinician scheduling. I'll publish a one-page risk register and update daily.
Lina (CSM): Renewal risk note: if clinicians don't see time savings within pilot, renewal is unlikely. We should instrument time-on-task metrics and capture qualitative notes during sessions.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Integration quickstart (for smoke test) to paste into terminal:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-mpt","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize patient note"}]}'
```
This checks auth, JSON payload, and basic response shape.
Elena (Quasar Health - Eng): We'll run smoke tonight and post results here. Also request: we want a 5-question feedback form after each clinician session (usability + accuracy + trust + speed + overall).
Lina (CSM): I'll create the form and wire results to the onboarding doc. We'll also record sessions (consent permitting) and collect prompt-level ratings.
Jordan (Onboarding PM): Scheduling: propose training + pilot kickoff Thurs 11am ET. Confirm by EOD.
Lina (CSM): Thu 11am ET works. Owners: Ravi -> integration & perf; Jordan -> schedule, risk register; Lina -> success metrics, survey; Elena -> SSO, schema, clinician roster. If blockers appear, @mention this thread or ping me directly. :rocket:
_meta: format: slack thread; messages are chronological; single continuous 'messages' string contains thread root and replies
